subject: Orbit MAP: Sprintboard, Canary & Acceptance Plan - Crestline Health
messages:

Subject: Orbit MAP: Sprintboard, Canary & Acceptance Plan - Crestline Health

Hi Elena / Crestline team,

Thanks again for signing — attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with a sprintboard view that embeds the post-signature implementation plan, evaluation checkpoints, and a proposed cutover timeline. High-level items included:

- Kickoff & governance: project kickoff + weekly ops cadence (owners: Crestline PM / Marcus)
- Canary window: limited-traffic canary (3 days) to validate performance under production traffic patterns
- Migration weekend: migration playbook and rollback gates
- Training & enablement: 2 instructor-led sessions + on-demand modules for ops and support
- Evaluation plan: acceptance testset (subset attached), SLO targets, and quality regression thresholds

Initial proposed dates (subject to your constraints):
- Kickoff: 2026-07-06 (30-45 min)
- Canary: 2026-07-12 — 2026-07-14 (target: 10% traffic split, two-node dedicated pool)
- Migration weekend: 2026-07-24 -> 2026-07-25 (night/low-traffic window)
- Training sessions: 2026-07-20 and 2026-07-22 (90m each)

Acceptance criteria (summary):
- Latency p95 <= 220ms for 90% of testset prompts
- Error rate < 0.5% for generation endpoints during canary
- Agreement score >= 90% on evaluation prompt set (see attached Evaluation_Criteria_and_Testset_v2.pdf)

To move forward we need three confirmations from you this week:
1) Confirmation on canary window dates (or propose alternatives)
2) List of attendees for the two training sessions (names + roles)
3) Any procurement hold/contract amendment needed for the reserved capacity during canary/migration

Attachments: MAP_Orbit_Sprintboard_Crestline_v1.xlsx (MAP), Evaluation_Criteria_and_Testset_v2.pdf (eval suite)

If those dates work I'll update the MAP and publish a shared calendar with owners and RACI.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin

Subject: Re: Orbit MAP: Sprintboard, Canary & Acceptance Plan - Crestline Health

Marcus — thanks for this. The MAP looks comprehensive. Quick items from our side:

- We have an internal maintenance blackout the week of 7/12 for a regulatory rollout. Can you move the canary earlier by one week? Prefer 7/05 - 7/07 (but that conflicts with your kickoff on 7/06).
- Procurement: we will need a short amendment to the contract to add the reserved capacity for the canary (2 nodes) and the migration weekend. I've looped in procurement above.
- Training: please keep the two sessions (we will provide attendees once procurement confirms the amendment).

Can Marcus / team propose a compact plan that allows a single-day kickoff + an earlier canary the first week of July?

— Elena
Elena Torres
VP Product Operations, Crestline Health
elena.torres@crestlinehealth.com

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbit MAP: Sprintboard, Canary & Acceptance Plan - Crestline Health

Elena / team — good point on the blackout. Proposed revision that keeps the evaluation integrity while respecting your constraints:

- Mini-kickoff (30m): 2026-06-30 — quick alignment call to confirm owners, RACI, and access.
- Canary (condensed): 2026-07-02 — run a full-day limited-cohort canary (08:00–20:00) with the evaluation testset and live traffic sampling at 5% (instead of 10%).
- Extended canary (if clear): follow-up three-day canary 2026-07-08 — 2026-07-10 (this is optional; we stage it in the MAP as contingency).
- Migration weekend: keep target 2026-07-24 -> 2026-07-25.

Rationale: the single-day condensed canary lets us validate config, KV cache behavior, and steady-state latency under real traffic while avoiding the regulatory blackout. If the 7/02 run is green, we can proceed with training and maintain the later migration weekend.

Action items for Crestline:
- Confirm 5–8 people for the condensed canary support shift (ops + QA + product)
- Procurement to expedite the amendment draft (we can accept a PO + amendment signature)

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet and push a revised sprintboard to Drive after we get confirmation on attendees.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success Operations
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Orbit MAP: Sprintboard, Canary & Acceptance Plan - Crestline Health

Quick technical note on the condensed canary (2026-07-02):

- Scope: limit to 3 representative endpoints + 10 evaluation prompt groups (from the attached eval PDF).
- Observability: we'll provision a temporary tracing tag and a cost telemetry hook so you can see token-level spend during the run.
- Rollback gates (predefined):
  * If p95 latency > 350ms for > 15 minutes -> auto-fail and rollback to previous model variant
  * If error rate > 1% (5xx, generation failures) over a 10m window -> pause traffic and investigate

I've attached a short runbook stub (Cutover_Runbook_stub.md) with steps we will follow during the canary and migration weekend. We'll flesh this out into a full runbook during sprint zero.

-Jonas
